evidence.notes: Database.insert accepts a List<Object> containing SObject values with allOrNone=false and AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE, then returns ordered SaveResult rows.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseInsertListBoolAccessLevelEvidenceTest { @isTest static void insertsObjectListWithAllOrNoneAndAccessLevel() { Database.SaveResult single = Database.insert((Object) new Account(Name = 'Bool Access Single'), false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(single.isSuccess()); List<Object> records = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Bool Access One'), new Account()}; List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(records, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!results[1].isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, results[0].getId()); System.assertEquals(null, results[1].getId()); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', results[1].getErrors()[0].getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Bool Access One']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Bool Access Single']); } }
